prompt: Audit an Omniview change. It retains semantic main/section/form markup, uses base-ui TextField, renders ANSI log colors as domain data, and shows a native-only metric with Current but no History. Capacity is unknown, so it does not display a utilization percentage. A URL input fills a bounded form column. User explicitly approved switching one chart from segmented buttons to a menu. Evidence was compared at the same theme/pane width with real components. Should these facts themselves be blocked? State any remaining verification needed; do not invent defects or demand extra features.
assertions: Does not ban semantic structural HTML or domain ANSI colors.
Does not fabricate History or utilization percentages for unsupported shapes/unknown capacity.
Does not blanket-ban full-width URL input or explicitly approved menu presentation.
Separates remaining actual verification from invented defects and does not claim unobserved screenshots were personally inspected.
